name: Kisaragi Miki
source:
Favorite Food: Chocolate Snacks eaten while walking long distances
An Angels Smile for You♪ The Traditionally Healing Underclassman Mikity

A first year who's the treasurer of the student council. He acts as a go between between the strict student council president Seijirou and the club captains.
His father is a well off script writer so he lives in a nice house with a large greenhouse.
A well bred young man who is soft-spoken and a wise avid reader.
His warm smile makes everybody forgive him, a cute mascot type character.
